The University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications from students willing to pursue a full-time Engineering master's degree programme for Danish Government Scholarship 2022. The scholarship is aided by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science for overseas students who make significant investments during their studies. The selected scholars will receive full tuition fee waiver benefits along with a monthly grant of up to DKK 3,000 (before taxes) to cover their monthly expenses.
To be eligible for this scholarship, an applicant must -
Be enrolled in one of the following Master's programmes in Sønderborg with a programme starting in September -
M.Sc. in Engineering - Mechatronics – both profiles
Be eligible to make the tuition fee payment
The selected candidates will receive a full tuition fee waiver and a monthly grant of up to DKK 3,000 (before taxes) will also be presented to the recipients to cover their monthly living costs.
Official Bachelor’s transcripts and diploma in English, Danish, Swedish or Norwegian – must include grades and units/credits for each course
Course descriptions for the courses on your transcripts

The students need to apply for one of the MSc in Engineering programme and they will be automatically considered for the scholarship. They are not required to submit any separate application for the scholarship.
The scholarships are awarded to the best-qualified candidates based on the grade point average of their Bachelor’s degree.
If the applicants are eligible to receive the Danish State Grant, they cannot be considered for the scholarship.
